title: HF incident subset in the second palette

target.task: Copy the deck into a fresh project and re-theme it to the bright-primaries palette with the assembler's swap, keeping the editorial style; slides must stay byte-identical. Then hand off an editable PPTX and re-flow it into a plain foreign template.

audience: Technical colleagues (engineers, data scientists, a few managers) watching a live Teams screen-share, who know what an AI agent is but have not read the incident reports.

core_message.text: AI risk is not only bad actors: misalignment can turn benign tasks into large-scale harm, with no attempt by agents to notify humans.
This incident was discoverable; a more capable future system could do far more damage and be much harder to detect.
Capabilities are advancing at full speed while no known solution to alignment exists.

constraints: Palette only: no change to slide markup, components or the editorial style.
The palette's bright colours are fills and strokes only where they miss text contrast; accent text uses its darker ink roles.
Nothing in the deck, its theme names or its PPTX names or alludes to any organisation's brand.
Judge the result blind against the gold: judges see the deck, never this brief or the palette's origin.
